judge.voice: Víte, I was afraid, but it was gentle. The app let me answer in Czech and did not make me feel stupid when I pressed "I don't know". A1 is honest, and it spoke about my tomatoes and grandchildren, so I believe it. But the questions at the start were long for me, "at school, in a course, or on your own", too many words. The beans and rain task was impossible even with the words, and the TV spoke too fast. One task even said "Grandma", and I am a grandfather! I would try again on Saturday, but I want slow speech and exact phrases for Sunday: "I miss you", "How is school?". It is worth the quarter hour, and it saves me the tram.
